\citet{jeong2025comparative} show that pairwise comparison amplifies style biases relative to pointwise scoring (the Comparative Trap), raising the concern that CSD's pairwise detection partly reflects format-level amplification.
Three observations bound this risk.
First, CSD's NLI gate blocks content-mediated amplification---the primary pathway in \citet{jeong2025comparative}---by ensuring pairs differ only in style.
